about: M5Stack CoreInk (current revision): outside dimensions and the openings in its enclosure, as measured for the stoprock case. Millimetres. See DIMENSIONS.md.
coordinates: Origin at the bottom-left-back corner as seen from the front (screen towards you, USB-C at the bottom). x: 0 at the left edge to 40 at the right. y: 0 at the bottom to 56 at the top. z: 0 at the back face to 16 at the front face. Features on the back are given in the same x as seen from the front (mirror x to read them from behind: 40 - x).

screen_window.note: opening in the front shell; the display's visible area is 27.6 x 27.6 (M5Stack)

corner_holes.note: from M5Stack's dimension drawing (32 x 48 mm apart)

dial_notch.note: the front shell is cut back round the dial

recessed_panel.note: a panel set slightly below the top face across most of the width

button.note: the top button's key, flush with the top face; M5Stack's drawing gives 7.4 wide, 22.3-29.7 from the left, including its surround

rear_recess.note: an opening in the back face at the top, behind the panel (expansion connector)

dial_window.note: the 3-way dial (up / press / down); the window runs through to the front face

reset_button.note: oval; x as seen from the front (from behind it is 6 mm from the right edge)
